body:
My entry says the orchard crew rinsed its sprayer upstream. The water turned milky, and my hands blistered before the bridge was blocked.

I thought the date would settle it. When I asked, the person at the barrier looked at the seal instead and handed it back.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the second vehicle was already gone.
title: camp notebook, page torn short
gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.
